title: Great App With Few Bugs
body:
Thank you Apple for this application. 

It is one of a kind app. It has many features that are not available elsewhere. 

But It needs some bug fixes. 

In the medication part, I noticed in many occasions that it removes some of my previously reported incidents. 

Like if I log in  my Friday medication as Taken, then Sunday medication, and so on, I would find on the following events that it removed those previously logged. Strange bug. 

It also has room for improvement in the sleep tracking part. 

Kindly fix.
